name: surface
title: Surface
description: Trays, sheets and wells: the material ladder every component is built on.
use: A panel, a group or a custom layout that shares the light and depth of the components. A tray holds sheets, a sheet is a raised face, a well sits below its surroundings.

instead.when: The sheet has media, a header, a body or a footer of actions
The sheet opens over the page from a button
The sheet holds a row of quiet controls

classes.name: sheet
classes.description: A raised face with a 16px corner, a half-pixel contour and the lifted shadow

classes.name: sheet-flat
classes.description: One contour and no shadow, for dense lists and tables

classes.name: sheet-raised
classes.description: The raised shadow, one step below the default, for small cards on a busy surface

classes.name: sheet-floating
classes.description: The floating surface and shadow, for popovers and menus over content

classes.name: sheet-inverse
classes.description: A sheet of ink with the inverse text color, for the one surface on a page that asks for something

classes.name: well
classes.description: A recessed surface with a 10px corner and an inset shadow

classes.name: tray
classes.description: A recessed holder for one or more sheets, with a 4px inset and a 20px corner around their 16px

properties.name: --surface-color
properties.description: The color of the sheet, read by a ring that cuts a shape out of the surface behind it; a floating and an inverse sheet set their own

properties.name: --surface-color
properties.description: The color of the well, read by a ring that cuts a shape out of the surface behind it

properties.name: --surface-color
properties.description: The color of the tray, read by a ring that cuts a shape out of the surface behind it
